phase: Final diagnostic snapshot following parent-task packaging. Earlier public and installed file observations remain identified separately; the final release is still unsigned.
conclusion: The examined installer and helper have no Authenticode publisher signature. The reported Smart App Control publisher block is consistent with this absence of trusted signing. A successful antivirus scan does not grant publisher trust.

installedFileExamined.limitation: Disk metadata and the observed health response are separate observations. The file is present and the local bridge responds; no live upgrade or process memory inspection was performed.

localReadOnlyBridgeCheck.limitation: This command-line GET confirms the current local bridge, not permission in every browser or readiness on another computer.

otherComputerCausesNotVerified: An unsigned installer or child executable may be refused by Smart App Control before the local bridge starts.
The user must actually open the installer once; saving a file in Downloads cannot install or start it from a webpage.
Chrome/Edge local-network permission for this HTTPS origin can be denied even when the helper is running.
A different preview/custom web origin is rejected by the existing exact-origin policy.
Port 8790 occupied by another process, missing .NET Framework 4.8, or disabled startup can leave the helper unavailable. These conditions were not inspected on another PC.

readinessFix.behavior: After starting its child the installer requires the exact read-only health contract within 8 seconds before reporting success. Failed start, unavailable bridge, wrong app, older version and timeout do not report Listo. The success message directs the user back to StudyRoom and Continuar.
upgradeOwnershipChecksPreserved: recheck immediately before stopping its own verified process
coverage: real HTTP health and origin rejection on isolated port
health does not mutate sharing leases
ready, unavailable, old version, incorrect app, malformed contract and bounded timeout
unknown hash, other path/session and foreign ownership rejection
readinessFix.securityLimitation: This readiness fix does not supply a trusted signature or remove Smart App Control blocks. Parent-task scan evidence identifies the final published hashes.

defenderEvidence.scanPerformedBy: parent task; no duplicate scan by this diagnosis task
defenderEvidence.limitation: Applies to these exact scanned hashes at that time; no guarantee for another antivirus, future detections or publisher trust.
